scan: First NYSE trading day each calendar month, 09:45 New York; one independent decision per stock/target tenor
model: all five; garch_t used only to construct forecast-independent near-ATM candidate metadata
selection: Nearest eligible expiry; nearest available valid strike to decision stock midpoint separately for CALL and PUT. Rank the two individual contracts by forecast_vol minus ask_IV. Buy at most one contract per stock/month/target tenor if the largest gap exceeds 0.03; deterministic CALL tie-break. Never package two legs into a straddle.
cost_gate: No legacy straddle pre-trade cost gate. Entry uses the single-option vol gap only; actual single-option and hedge costs are reported in replay. No ranking on future P&L.
entry: 10:00 New York after the 09:45 decision; require valid observed chosen-option and stock quotes, otherwise record failed execution and do not switch legs
exit: 15 minutes before the exchange close on the session before expiry; next eligible liquidation quote if necessary, or explicit zero-bid abandonment at that time. No actual early-exercise simulation.
capital: Independently funded three times entry 100-share underlying notional. Maintain research reserve and report any exit differences. No portfolio return or leverage inference.
sessions: NYSE regular sessions; whole-share stock hedges from strictly past single-option market-IV Delta, displayed-size limits; no overnight hedges or interpolation
costs: Use the existing StockCosts observed bid/ask, commission, sell surcharge, 1bp slippage, financing and borrow assumptions. Matched midpoint/zero-execution-cost comparison retains financing, cash benchmark, stock borrow and unbid-rights writeoff.
unsupported_corporate_actions: Record all candidates crossing an observed split as unsupported adjusted-contract data, without substituting another leg or tenor. Coverage exclusion is disclosed, not a forecast rule.
research_status: Chronological 2026 holdout with previously unexamined option P&L; rules fixed before retrieving 2026 decision chains or outcomes. Not a prospective live test. Universe and rules chosen using prior exploratory 2022-2025 work.
purchase_policy: Existing authenticated data entitlement only; no purchases or subscription changes

training.refit: monthly, before the first session 09:45 NY decision; past completed labels only
training.feature_timing: Prior actual session close. No same-day high, low, close or volume. No option IV input to ML.
training.target: Mean future squared close-to-close log returns within each block, using only blocks fully observed before each fitting cutoff
training.trade_comparison: Same 480 original candidates; 60-minute hedges, +3 volatility point buffer and unchanged cost gate; strict and zero-bid scenarios separately
training.research_status: Exploratory historical comparison; original 2022-2025 market outcomes have already been examined, so this is not a new untouched holdout
training.intraday_limitation: Training labels are daily squared-return variance proxies, not continuous high-frequency realized variance; HAR model is a proxy version, not original HAR-RV
training.model_selection: All listed models are reported; no winner is selected by trading P&L

fit_protocol: Monthly walk-forward. Rolling 756 past anchor dates; pooled supervised labels must end no later than prior session close. Matured labels from earlier test months may enter later fits. No hyperparameter or threshold tuning on holdout.

protocols.label: Every 60 elapsed minutes in regular hours

comparison: Same 420 opportunities per model. All five models disclosed. Flat opportunities count as zero trading P&L. Each unique selected option replayed once and joined to models selecting it: forecast affects entry only; market-IV Delta and exits are common.
holdout_window_rationale: July last origin plus maximum admissible 115 calendar-day expiry is fully observed by 2026-11-02; no selection of origins based on their returns.
forecast_scoring: All stock-month 5/21/63-session forecasts independently of entry signals; daily squared-return proxy QLIKE and MAE. Separate executed-trade 15-minute plus overnight RV versus actual entry ask-IV hit rate.
